notes.title: «Warehouse» map Concept
notes.content:
[h3]Hey [b]freelancers![/b][/h3][p]We’re finally ready to unveil our latest experiment — the “[b]Warehouse[/b]” map. We're putting a lot of effort into making maps and gamemodes that feel fresh, dynamic, and genuinely fun to play.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45614182/ebf3edf70d2fc99abea5fea0a1e6381ad46cbf78.png"][/img][/p][p]This one's set in an abandoned distribution center on the outskirts of a megacity, where rusting beams clash with sleek, mirror-like racing lanes. Every route and every prop is carefully designed to balance fast-paced action with immersive atmosphere.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45614182/c975755d4c39be9bce5f0ecce872cb6c5adf8fb7.png"][/img][/p][p]No humans here — just hangars turned into arenas for high-octane battles. Expect graffiti, forgotten cargo, derelict structures, and scattered debris across this gritty new playground.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45614182/d17a999f1d96ba843aa5a0af3fc792e725449859.png"][/img][/p][p]What do you think of the “[b]Warehouse[/b]” concept?
What maps from other games stuck with you — and why?
We’d love to hear your thoughts![/p][p]With love,
[b]TahomoGames[/b] dev team[/p]

notes.title: Wow! Is this... GLIDEs??
notes.content: [h1]Hi everyone![/h1][p]We are pleased to share a series of GIFs and models that reveal the character and visual personality of some of our glides. Each of them was created with attention to detail — not only for the sake of beauty, but also to convey the unique sensations of flight, emphasize the style and enhance gameplay features.[/p][p][b]Zero Formula[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45614182/cf27e3d62f4e3e134bdab86db3dc5d214c2a633e.gif"][/img][/p][p]First glide - aggression, speed and energy.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45614182/79465b1c0b1d36fcf2b106343db0a7c162303807.png"][/img][/p][p]Its hull has powerful turbines, from which bright fire jets escape, leaving only a bright trail behind them. Fast and charged, ZeroFormula will give you the spirit of a real race and instant acceleration. This guide is designed for those who like to take every turn to the limit of their abilities.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Goliaf[/b] [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45614182/92364e3819486b3aa660dea7e713b5deef4ea9a6.gif"][/img][/p][p]The new generation glide from Reswit Corporation - massive, aesthetic and challenging.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45614182/0c88d3c06022eacadc88c3f4cefb6b92a7496e89.jpg"][/img] [/p][p]Six cylindrical turbines, three on each side, resemble the paws of a mechanical predator, ready for rapid maneuver. This design gives Goliaf a special grace and control in the air. The green light accents emphasize the feeling of energy circulating inside.  This glide sets a new standard in engineering — reliable and memorable. It is designed for those who are used to dominating not at the expense of speed, but at the expense of maneuverability.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Suwan[/b] [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45614182/4449fbf748966ffc2aae8d500646d6cdfc9f7158.gif"][/img][/p][p]Finally, meet Glide Suwan, the epitome of futurism and biomechanics.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45614182/9fbd623b01b301c9717730993dea3924da7f0374.png"][/img][/p][p]Its black hull with metallic accents is inspired by the anatomy of a bat: graceful curves, webbed wings and a strict, streamlined silhouette. Four engines provide excellent aerodynamics and impressive acceleration. This guide is designed for those who prefer nighttime elegance and speed.[/p][p]We want our glides to become unique in their every move. Share your impressions — which of these glides would you choose first?[/p][p]Leave your ideas, share your thoughts — it is important for us to know which of the glides is closer to you![/p][p]Love, [/p][p]TahomoGames team💙[/p]

tags.feature: We are pleased to share a series of GIFs and models that reveal the character and visual personality of some of our glides. Each of them was created with attention to detail — not only for the sake of beauty, but also to convey the unique sensations of flight, emphasize the style and enhance gameplay features.
First glide - aggression, speed and energy.

Its hull has powerful turbines, from which bright fire jets escape, leaving only a bright trail behind them. Fast and charged, ZeroFormula will give you the spirit of a real race and instant acceleration. This guide is designed for those who like to take every turn to the limit of their abilities.
The new generation glide from Reswit Corporation - massive, aesthetic and challenging.

Six cylindrical turbines, three on each side, resemble the paws of a mechanical predator, ready for rapid maneuver. This design gives Goliaf a special grace and control in the air. The green light accents emphasize the feeling of energy circulating inside.  This glide sets a new standard in engineering — reliable and memorable. It is designed for those who are used to dominating not at the expense of speed, but at the expense of maneuverability.
Finally, meet Glide Suwan, the epitome of futurism and biomechanics.

Its black hull with metallic accents is inspired by the anatomy of a bat: graceful curves, webbed wings and a strict, streamlined silhouette. Four engines provide excellent aerodynamics and impressive acceleration. This guide is designed for those who prefer nighttime elegance and speed.
